title: skeleton template variables
description: Values for templates/skeleton.md.j2 and templates/skeleton.html.j2. Field names match content/02-output-contract.xml; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

rfc_id.title: RFC id
rfc_id.description: What is the RFC number, as RFC-NNN?

title.title: Title
title.description: What is the RFC called, in terms of the outcome rather than the technology?

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Which tech lead authors and owns the RFC through its outcome review, as role:handle?

status.title: Status
status.description: Is the RFC proposed, accepted, rejected or superseded?

shared_on.title: Shared on
shared_on.description: On which date was the RFC shared with reviewers, as YYYY-MM-DD?

by_date.title: By date
by_date.description: By which date must the target be met, as YYYY-MM-DD?

problem_statement.title: Problem statement
problem_statement.description: What is the current state and why does it matter, with the numbers? Name no solution.

chosen_option.title: Chosen option
chosen_option.description: Which approach is chosen, in one line?

rejected_option.title: Rejected option
rejected_option.description: Which real alternative implementation was considered and rejected?

rejection_reason.title: Rejection reason
rejection_reason.description: Why was it rejected, tied to the metric, cost or risk?

rollback_mechanism.title: Rollback mechanism
rollback_mechanism.description: How is the change undone — feature flag off, revert PR, down-migration or config revert?

rollback_minutes.title: Rollback minutes
rollback_minutes.description: How many minutes does the rollback take to execute, as measured in staging?

rollback_executor.title: Rollback executor
rollback_executor.description: Who can execute the rollback, as role:handle (an on-call rotation counts)?

milestone_1_date.title: First milestone date
milestone_1_date.description: On which date is the first demonstrable increment, as YYYY-MM-DD?

milestone_1_increment.title: First milestone increment
milestone_1_increment.description: What can a reviewer click, query or observe at the first milestone?

ship_date.title: Ship date
ship_date.description: On which date does the change ship, at most 42 days after the first milestone?

ship_increment.title: Ship increment
ship_increment.description: What is observable when it ships?

comment_deadline.title: Comment deadline
comment_deadline.description: By which date must reviewers comment, at least 3 working days after shared_on?

metric_url.title: Metric URL
metric_url.description: Which dashboard or query URL shows the problem metric?
